notes.addenda: The eight addenda amending loaded colleges' catalogs were read on Oct 14 and filed on Oct 14 as read, each with the programs and courses it changes. The other 71 listed addenda wait for the reader to reach their colleges.
notes.procedures: 76 colleges have one: the eLumen six and the first S402 wave's four were written on Oct 17, and the 28 whose map host refuses or never reaches the reader each name the routes tried.
notes.sierra: The funding explainer's text is editable on the Implementation Funding tab since Oct 9, and its controls are underlined words, the First Light rule from that day.
notes.maps: All 32 published maps are settled since Oct 8; Palo Verde's map columns were written that evening.
notes.reading: Cerritos read on Oct 9 and Mt. San Antonio on Oct 10. RCCD's three colleges were read on Oct 10 and their Liberal Arts emphasis programs recovered on Oct 11. 18 records that read another program's page were removed on Oct 11. Long Beach City was read on Oct 11 and re-read on Oct 12: 344 records, unchecked. Chaffey was read and loaded on Oct 12: 191 records, unchecked, for 1,745 in all. Palo Verde's records come from its 2025-26 catalog; its 2026-27 catalog is on a platform the reader does not read yet.

changes.text: The reader learned to find each program in a Coursedog catalog PDF by the program code printed beside its name.
Hartnell gained 8 records and 14 of its records moved to their own program's pages.
Four Hartnell records that showed another program's requirements were removed, each kept whole in a receipt.
Display build 182e810e207d covers 15,651 programs at 111 colleges.
The reader learned to walk SmartCatalog catalogs, and Crafton Hills was read without extraction.
